text:
Noah: Heads up — someone listed a mystery snack box as trade collateral in our league chat. What is happening.
Tara: It was me. Mystery snack box = donuts + surprise hot sauce. High-value.
Ibrahim: Wait donuts as collateral? That should be auctioned.
Noah: Also my autopick misfired and started a cascade of bench panic. Can anyone undo an autopick?
mica-bot: autopick log: Noah autopickPriority=1 triggered at 02:08am.
Tara: @Noah I can swap you one bench player if you Venmo a donut.
Ibrahim: Auction idea: winner gets the mystery box and the loser gets a consolation kombucha.
trade-bot: trade proposed: Tara -> Noah: Mystery Snack Box for bench-RB K. Penn. Status: pending.
Noah: That is borderline extortion but tempting. How many donuts are we talking.
Tara: 6. Fresh. Photo proof required.
Ibrahim: I vote to allow edible collateral. Adds spice to the league.
Noah: Fine. If trade passes, I want the mystery hot sauce named in the documentation. No anonymous condiments.
mica-bot: poll created: "Allow edible collateral (donuts/snacks) in trades?" React :thumbsup: Yes, :thumbsdown: No, :eyes: Case-by-case.
Tara: Also shoutout to @mica-bot for catching the autopick time-travel.
Ibrahim: If this passes, we should add a rule: remote members send Paypal + photo to commish within 48 hours.
Noah: Vote now. If I win both the trade and the mystery hot sauce, I will accept full responsibility for trash talk.
trade-bot: trade status: pending commish approval.
mica-bot: reminder: playoffs in 2 weeks. Keep benches warm and snack budgets balanced.
